title: Loss Mitigation — Retention Eligibility
subtitle: 19 delinquent loans · GSE retention waterfall

kpis.label: Loans in book
kpis.helper: Every loan currently being evaluated in this stage of loss mitigation.

kpis.label: Facially Complete
kpis.helper: We modify the loan permanently — lower rate, longer term, sometimes principal forbearance — and the borrower must first complete a 3-month trial at the new payment.

kpis.label: Denied
kpis.helper: Borrower does not qualify for any retention option. Moves to a non-retention path (short sale, deed-in-lieu, or foreclosure).

kpis.label: Facially Incomplete
kpis.helper: Engine can't decide yet because Stage 1 intake docs are still missing or stale. Goes back to Intake.

kpis.label: In Human Review
kpis.helper: Loans where a human reviewer is actively triaging the case before the next step.
